hero.lede: A single 3D scan documents your entire property. You receive up to three strictly comparable bids — no repeat visits, no blind spots, no surprises.
hero.scan_alt: 3D scan of a property documented by Estimation3D

problem.sub: When a problem hits your home, you call around. Three visits, three sets of measurements, three vocabularies — and in the end, a decision made blind.
problem.i_d: Each contractor shows up, measures, leaves. You tell the same story three times. You wait.
problem.ii_d: Three quotes written three different ways. Surfaces, methods, warranties: nothing lines up directly.
problem.iii_d: No neutral third party. You decide alone, with a vocabulary you're learning as you go.
problem.iv_t: And if something unexpected turns up?
problem.iv_d: With no agreed protocol, every discovery becomes a negotiation. The project slips — and so does the budget.

process.sub: Our technician comes once, captures the property in 3D, measures and classifies. The file then goes to up to three qualified contractors — who bid without traveling.
process.s1_t: The property, captured to the millimetre.
process.s1_d: Drag the slider: a raw survey becomes a file where every room, every surface, every opening is quantified. No eyeballing, nothing missed.
process.s2_t: A file no one can dispute.
process.s2_d: Surfaces, perimeters, problem classification: everything is quantified on a single basis. All three contractors bid on exactly the same data.

services.sub: Each field has its own standards, warranties and critical timelines. We document to the trade's real requirements — hover for detail.
services.mold_d: Identification, perimeter, decontamination protocol and ventilation.
services.water_d: Source, extent, drying, rebuild. Critical timelines.
services.asbestos_d: Pre-1980 homes. Testing, encapsulation, compliant removal.
services.demolition_d: Room, level, structure. Evacuation plan and waste management.
services.insulation_d: Attics, walls, basement. Thermal bridges and ventilation.
services.foundations_d: Thermal camera, cracks, infiltration, French drain.

compare.w1: Three visits, three retellings of the problem.
compare.w2: Each quote written in its own language.
compare.w3: Surprises negotiated on the fly, case by case.
compare.w4: Follow-up scattered across texts and calls.
compare.with_t: You decide on a single basis.

quote.c: , so no decision is ever made in the dark.
quote.who: Over 10 years of residential decontamination · Montréal

cta.lede: Document your project once. Receive up to three comparable bids. Decide with confidence.

form.sub: Tell us about your property. We'll get back within 24 hours to schedule the single documentation visit.
form.name: Full name
form.desc_ph: A few words on what you're seeing: stains, smells, visible damage, since when…
form.note: Flat rate $399 for the visit. No commitment beyond documentation. Response within 24 h.
form.success: File received. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.

footer.tagline: Document once, carefully, so no decision is ever made in the dark. An Hygienaction initiative, Montréal.
